options.content: **延迟看尾部，错误看比例，流量看需求，压力辅助定位。**　请求曲线从接入时开始；空白表示没有样本或采集不可用，不做零值回填。资源曲线同时保留迁移前的只读 PostgreSQL 历史。

panels.title: 成功请求延迟 · 5 分钟窗口
panels.description: 跨服务分位数由合并的直方图桶计算，不平均各服务P95。

targets.expr: (1000 * histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) ((server_monitor:http_success_duration_seconds_bucket:rate5m{service=~"$service"} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_success_duration_seconds_bucket:rate5m{service=~"$service"}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9))))) and on () ((max(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"}) == 1) and (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"})) < 45))

(1000 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) ((server_monitor:http_success_duration_seconds_bucket:rate5m{service=~"$service"} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_success_duration_seconds_bucket:rate5m{service=~"$service"}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9))))) and on () ((max(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"}) == 1) and (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"})) < 45))

(1000 * histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) ((server_monitor:http_success_duration_seconds_bucket:rate5m{service=~"$service"} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_success_duration_seconds_bucket:rate5m{service=~"$service"}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9))))) and on () ((max(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"}) == 1) and (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"})) < 45))

panels.title: 失败请求延迟 · 仅 5xx
panels.description: 成功与失败请求分开；没有失败样本时不画0ms。

targets.expr: (1000 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) ((server_monitor:http_server_error_duration_seconds_bucket:rate5m{service=~"$service"} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_server_error_duration_seconds_bucket:rate5m{service=~"$service"}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9))))) and on () ((max(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"}) == 1) and (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"})) < 45))

(1000 * histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) ((server_monitor:http_server_error_duration_seconds_bucket:rate5m{service=~"$service"} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_server_error_duration_seconds_bucket:rate5m{service=~"$service"}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9))))) and on () ((max(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"}) == 1) and (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"})) < 45))

panels.title: 请求流量 · 状态分类
panels.description: 近1分钟速率的历史采样，排除监控流量和长连接。

targets.expr: (sum((server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service",status=~"[23].."} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service",status=~"[23].."}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9)))) and on () ((max(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"}) == 1) and (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"})) < 45))

(sum((server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service",status=~"4.."} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service",status=~"4.."}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9)))) and on () ((max(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"}) == 1) and (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"})) < 45))

(sum((server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service",status=~"5.."} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service",status=~"5.."}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9)))) and on () ((max(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"}) == 1) and (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"})) < 45))

panels.title: 错误比例 · 5xx 与 4xx 分开
panels.description: 分母为0时无样本；4xx不自动等同于服务端故障。

targets.expr: (100 * (sum((server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service",status=~"5.."} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service",status=~"5.."}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9))) or (sum((server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service"} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service"}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9))) * 0)) / (sum((server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service"} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service"}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9))) > 0)) and on () ((max(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"}) == 1) and (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"})) < 45))

(100 * (sum((server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service",status=~"4.."} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service",status=~"4.."}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9))) or (sum((server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service"} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service"}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9))) * 0)) / (sum((server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service"} and (timestamp(server_monitor:http_requests:rate1m{service=~"$service"}) == scalar(max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})))) and on () (max(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"}) > time() - 9) and on () (max(timestamp(server_monitor_http_recorded_at_seconds{host_id="cloud-primary"})) > time() - 9))) > 0)) and on () ((max(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"}) == 1) and (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="server-monitor-http",host_id="cloud-primary"})) < 45))

panels.title: 共享主机资源
panels.description: 以实际时间桶聚合，缺失桶留空；旧资源来自受限只读视图，保留原切换边界。

targets.expr: avg_over_time(server_monitor_host_cpu_percent{host_id="cloud-primary"}[$__interval])
avg_over_time(server_monitor_host_memory_used_percent{host_id="cloud-primary"}[$__interval])
avg_over_time(server_monitor_host_swap_used_percent{host_id="cloud-primary"}[$__interval])
avg_over_time(server_monitor_host_disk_used_percent{host_id="cloud-primary"}[$__interval])

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(collected_at, '$__interval'), avg(cpu_percent) AS "CPU", avg(memory_percent) AS "内存", avg(swap_percent) AS "Swap", avg(disk_percent) AS "磁盘" FROM public.monitor_grafana_resource_history WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
